Bumps the github-actions group with 3 updates in the / directory: [Swatinem/rust-cache](https://github.com/swatinem/rust-cache), [rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action](https://github.com/rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action) and [taiki-e/install-action](https://github.com/taiki-e/install-action). Updates `Swatinem/rust-cache` from 2.9.2 to 2.9.3
Release notes

Sourced from Swatinem/rust-cache's releases.

v2.9.3

What's Changed

  • Issue-375: stop cleanup timestamp pruning after the first entry by @​TethysSvensson in Swatinem/rust-cache#377
  • fix: log rustup toolchain list failure as info instead of warning by @​SDAChess in Swatinem/rust-cache#394

New Contributors

  • @​TethysSvensson made their first contribution in Swatinem/rust-cache#377
  • @​SDAChess made their first contribution in Swatinem/rust-cache#394

Full Changelog: https://github.com/Swatinem/rust-cache/compare/v2.9.2...v2.9.3

Changelog

Sourced from Swatinem/rust-cache's changelog.

Changelog

2.9.3

  • Fix timestamp based pruning
  • Add missing awaits
  • Do not emit warning on missing rustup

2.9.2

  • Fix credentials.toml cleanup
  • Improvements to cleanup, preserving more valid targets
  • Improvements to cargo install handling
  • Correctly sort/dedupe Rust versions

2.9.1

  • Fix regression in hash calculation

2.9.0

  • Update to node24
  • Support running from within a nix shell
  • Consider all installed toolchains for cache key
  • Use case-insensitive comparison to determine exact cache hit

2.8.2

  • Don't overwrite env for cargo-metadata call

2.8.1

  • Set empty CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS when retrieving metadata
  • Various dependency updates

2.8.0

  • Add support for warpbuild cache provider
  • Add new cache-workspace-crates feature

2.7.8

  • Include CPU arch in the cache key

2.7.7

  • Also cache cargo install metadata

2.7.6
